places.name: Heidelberg Castle
places.ai_summary: A romantic ruin overlooking the Neckar River, offering stunning views and a glimpse into Germany's history.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Take the funicular railway for an easy ascent.

attribution.title: Heidelberg-2726936
attribution.author: Motatcho
attribution.description: Heidelberger Schloss. Der 6. September 1693 war ein Schicksalstag für das Schloss. Französische Truppen sprengten das Monument mit ca. 27.000 Pfund Schwarzpulverpulver  – noch heute treten die Spuren der Sprengung deutlich vor Augen.

places.name: Black Forest (Schwarzwald)
places.ai_summary: A vast forested mountain range known for its picturesque villages, cuckoo clocks, and hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions within the forest may have specific timings.

places.place_tip: Explore the Triberg Waterfalls and try the famous Black Forest cake.

attribution.title: Blick vom Hohfelsen
attribution.author: MWolf89
attribution.description: View from the Hohfelsen near Seebach in Germany.

places.name: Lake Constance (Bodensee)
places.ai_summary: A large lake bordering Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, known for its water sports and scenic beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Boat tours and attractions may have specific timings.

places.place_tip: Visit Mainau Island for its beautiful gardens.

places.name: Mercedes-Benz Museum (Stuttgart)
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history of the Mercedes-Benz brand and its vehicles, located in Stuttgart.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially for guided tours.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the vehicle exhibition and the panoramic terrace.

attribution.title: Mercedes-Benz Museum 201312 08 blue hour
attribution.author: Julian Herzog (Website)
attribution.description: Mercedes-Benz Museum in Stuttgart, Germany, during blue hour.

places.name: Hohenzollern Castle
places.ai_summary: A picturesque hilltop castle with a rich history, offering guided tours and stunning views of the surrounding countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 1 hour before closing. Closed on December 24th and 31st.

places.place_tip: Visit the castle chapel and enjoy the view from the terrace.

attribution.title: Burg Hohenzollern 10-2016
attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: Hohenzollern Castle in Bisingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

places.name: Ulm Minster
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of Gothic architecture, famous for its tall steeple and intricate interior.

opening_hours.notes: Climbing the tower requires a ticket. Closed on January 1st, December 24th, 25th, and 31st.

places.place_tip: Climb the tower for a panoramic view of Ulm and the Danube.

attribution.title: Landappbw 526530 1820 Ulmer Münster Luftaufnahme Ulmer Münster (cropped)
attribution.author: Armin Appel
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: Triberg Waterfalls
places.ai_summary: Germany's highest waterfalls, located in the Black Forest, with walking paths and viewing platforms.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited from May to October. Check local conditions in winter.

places.place_tip: Take the circular walking trail for the best views.
places.address: Triberg Waterfalls, 78098 Triberg im Schwarzwald, Germany

places.name: Mainau Island
places.ai_summary: A beautiful island in Lake Constance, known for its stunning gardens and floral displays.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 1 hour before closing. Closed from November to March.

places.place_tip: Visit the butterfly house and the palm house.

attribution.title: Aus dem Zeppelin fotografiert, Insel Mainau, Bodensee. 10
attribution.author: Holger Uwe Schmitt
attribution.description: Island of Mainau, Lake Constance, photographed from Zeppelin.

places.name: Lichtenstein Castle
places.ai_summary: A fairy-tale castle perched on a cliff, offering guided tours and breathtaking views of the Swabian Alps.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 1 hour before closing. Closed on December 24th and 31st.

places.place_tip: The castle is best accessed by car. Check for guided tour timings.

attribution.title: Schloss Lichtenstein 04-2010
attribution.author: -donald-
attribution.description: Lichtenstein Castle, near Lichtenstein, in Baden-Württemberg, Germany.

places.name: Freiburg Old Town
places.ai_summary: The historic old town of Freiburg, featuring medieval buildings, narrow streets, and the famous Freiburg Minster.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Augustiner Museum and the historic merchant's hall.

attribution.title: Freiburg im Breisgau Münster
attribution.author: C. M.
attribution.description: Außenansicht des Münsters in Freiburg im Breisgau

places.name: Karlsruhe Palace
places.ai_summary: A baroque palace in Karlsruhe, now home to a museum and the Baden State Museum.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the palace gardens and the museum's exhibitions.

attribution.author: A.Savin
attribution.description: The palace in Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

places.name: Maulbronn Monastery
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved medieval monastery, now a UNESCO World Heritage site, known for its architecture and tranquil gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 1 hour before closing. Closed on December 24th and 31st.

places.place_tip: Attend a guided tour to learn about the monastery's history.

attribution.title: Courtyard facade - Maulbronn Monastery
attribution.author: H. Zell
attribution.description: Courtyard facade of the Maulbronn Monastery, Maulbronn, Germany

places.name: Tübingen Old Town
places.ai_summary: The charming old town of Tübingen, with its well-preserved medieval buildings and vibrant student life.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Eberhard Karls University and the Hölderlin Tower.

places.name: Europa-Park (Rust)
places.ai_summary: Germany's largest theme park, featuring a wide range of rides, shows, and themed areas.

opening_hours.notes: Opening hours vary by season. Check the official website for details.

places.place_tip: Try to catch the evening show for a spectacular end to your visit.

attribution.title: Haupteingang (main entrance) Europa-Park Rust
attribution.author: Gabriel Rinaldi

places.name: Stuttgart Television Tower
places.ai_summary: A TV tower in Stuttgart with an observation deck offering panoramic views of the city and surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 30 minutes before closing. Closed on December 24th and 31st.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trip to the nearby Rosenstein Park.

places.name: Esslingen Medieval Town
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved medieval town near Stuttgart, with half-timbered houses and a historic castle.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Esslingen Castle for a great view of the town.

places.name: Baden-Baden Thermal Baths
places.ai_summary: Famous thermal baths in Baden-Baden, offering a range of wellness and spa treatments.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for treatments. Closed on December 24th and 31st.

places.best_time_to_visit: Anytime, but especially relaxing in winter
places.place_tip: Try the Friedrichsbad for a traditional Roman-Irish bath experience.

places.name: Wiblingen Abbey Library
places.ai_summary: A beautiful baroque library located in the Wiblingen Abbey, known for its stunning interior and historic significance.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the nearby Wiblingen Abbey.

places.name: Ravensburg Game Museum
places.ai_summary: A unique museum dedicated to games and play, featuring a wide range of exhibits and interactive displays.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check the museum's schedule for special events and workshops.

places.name: Swabian Alb Biosphere Reserve
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO biosphere reserve featuring stunning landscapes, diverse wildlife, and numerous hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor centers may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Laichingen Deep Well and the Hohlenstein Cave.
places.address: Swabian Alb Biosphere Reserve, 72574 Bad Urach, Germany
